title: Spike-in cell lines as an experimental ground truth for batch effect
abstract: Spike-in cell lines sequenced in every batch give an experimental ground truth for batch effect that is independent of cell-type labels. Scoring against it reverses the top-two ranking from label-based benchmarks.

fulltext_excerpt: We propose a design that sidesteps curated labels. Spike-in cell lines sequenced in every batch give an experimental ground truth for batch effect that is independent of cell-type labels. Because the spike-in cells are the same in every batch, any difference between them after integration is residual batch effect. Scoring against the spike-in ground truth reverses the ranking of the top two methods reported by label-based benchmarks. The previous leader over-mixed the spike-in lines with neighbouring primary cells. Simulated batches used in prior benchmarks lack a biological ground truth, and our spike-in design applies only to newly generated data. Existing public datasets cannot be rescored this way. We release the dataset and the scoring code.
